definitions.explanation: extremely hard and concentrated practice or training, often over a sustained period

examples.japanese: {猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}んだ→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
examples.english: I devoted myself to intensive practice before the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to daily intensive practice, she finally won the national championship.

notes:
Describes a level of practice or training that goes far beyond normal effort — grueling, relentless, and sustained. Composed of {猛|もう} (fierce, intense) + ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ (practice). Often associated with sports, music, and martial arts in Japan, where a culture of ⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧ (guts, perseverance) values pushing through hardship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ — to practice intensively again and again
- {猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧ — to devote oneself to intensive training
- {猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧ — the results of rigorous practice
- {猛練習|もうれんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧ — days of intensive training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特訓|とっくん}→特訓：13466_tokkun⟧ — special/intensive training (often one-on-one or focused on a weak point)
- ⟦{猛特訓|もうとっくん}→猛特訓：24374_moutokkun⟧ — extremely intensive special training (even more intense)
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ — practice (neutral, general term)
- ⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧ — practice, rehearsal (traditional arts, martial arts)
